content: Besides hardware and software resources, the FrIf module also numbers the logical structure elements presented by FlexRay with an abstract, unique, zero-based consecutive index. The static configuration data of the FrIf module contains a data structure that specifies which FlexRay CC modules and which FlexRay Transceiver modules are connected to which Clusters, or in other words, that maps each value of FrIf_ClstIdx to (one, or in general) a set of values for FrIf_CtrlIdx and tuples of (FrIfCtrlIIdx, FrIf_ChnlIdx).
